facts.function: optical filter altering light for photography
facts.form: not stated whether mounted in a ring/frame; presumed unmounted filter elements

gri_path: GRI 1: optically worked glass filters are optical elements of chapter 90; chapter 70 applies only to glass elements not optically worked (chapter 90 note 1 / heading 9001 text)
Heading 9001 covers optical elements unmounted; heading 9002 covers them mounted, as parts or fittings of instruments. Assumed unmounted
GRI 6: 9001.90 other; not lenses, prisms, mirrors or halftone screens -> 9001.90.90.00

rejected_alternatives.reason: mounted photographic filters; would apply if the filters are mounted in rings/frames for fitting to cameras or lenses
optical glass elements not optically worked; photographic filters are optically worked
halftone screens for engraving or photographic processes are a different article

missing_facts: Are the filters mounted (e.g. in threaded metal rings or holders for camera lenses)? Mounted filters go to 9002.20.40.00
classification.rationale: Glass photographic filters are optically worked optical elements of chapter 90. The heading depends on whether they are mounted: unmounted filters fall in 9001.90.90.00 and mounted photographic filters in 9002.20.40.00. NY H81010 (in force) classified unmounted glass photographic optical filters in 9001.90.9000, so that code is the best guess here. Mounting must be confirmed.
